paper.core_task: Training stable and scalable continuous-time consistency models for few-step image generation

contributions.name: A unified diffusion formulation combining EDM and flow matching
contributions.author_claim_text: Our first contribution is TrigFlow, a new formulation that unifies EDM and Flow Matching, significantly simplifying the formulation of diffusion models, the associated probability flow ODE and CMs.
contributions.description: Proposes TrigFlow, a new formulation that unifies EDM and flow matching, simplifying the diffusion process, model parameterization, probability flow ODE, and consistency model definitions using trigonometric functions.

contributions.name: Techniques for stabilizing continuous-time consistency model training
contributions.author_claim_text: Building on this foundation, we analyze the root causes of instability in CM training and propose a complete recipe for mitigation.
contributions.description: Introduces a set of stabilization techniques including positional time embeddings, adaptive double normalization, tangent normalization, adaptive weighting, and tangent warmup to address instability in continuous-time consistency model training.

contributions.name: Jacobian-vector product computation for Flash Attention
contributions.author_claim_text: To fill this gap, we propose a similar algorithm that efficiently computes both softmax selfattention and its JVP in a single forward pass in the style of Flash Attention.
contributions.description: Develops an algorithm to compute the Jacobian-vector product (JVP) of softmax self-attention in a single forward pass, enabling memory-efficient training of large-scale continuous-time consistency models with Flash Attention.

novelty_claims.text: The paper proposes a new formulation of consistency models (CM) that unifies EDM and flow matching.
